title: workflows: meta-learning models of machine learning workflow performance

creators.name: Neruda, Roman
creators.affiliation: Institute of Computer Science, Czech Academy of Sciences

description:
Research code for predicting, recommending and explaining the performance of machine learning workflows (scikit-learn flows) on OpenML tasks, using meta-learning over historical OpenML evaluations. Workflows are represented by their textual descriptions (TF-IDF, count, hashing, MiniLM embeddings) combined with dataset meta-features.

Contents: the core pipeline (openml_flow.py) with task-grouped cross-validation, statistical testing and SHAP-based explanation-quality metrics; sncs/, the study for the SN Computer Science article Learning from Prior Experiments: Meta-Learning Models of Workflow Performance; lacci/, experiments for the LACCI 2026 paper on lexical vs dense workflow representations; and recommender/, scripts for the warm-start AutoML recommender line of work.

This work has been funded by a grant from the Programme Johannes Amos Comenius under the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports of the Czech Republic, CZ.02.01.01/00/23_025/0008711.
